name: 993 timing chain case and its lids
description: Investigation target: the chain case from factory plate 103-05, its three lids, its oil bridges and its tensioner. The record establishes identity and material reasoning; it is neither a replacement geometry nor a manufacturing authorization. Selected because the factory catalogue triage makes it a serious consolidation case — and because the titanium grid rejects it three times.

classification.intended_use: Documentary investigation and process comparison; no manufacturing, no fitting, no start-up

provenance.record_license: MIT for the record; no third-party geometry redistributed

sources.title: 993 factory catalogue, plate 103-05 Chain case
sources.notes: Identifies two `chain case`, three `lid`, two `chain adjuster`, one `bearing`, one `heat protection plate` and three `bridge`, two of which are also described as `oil gallery`. Establishes no dimension, no material and no interface. See SRC-PET-993-103-05-CHAIN-CASE.

material.family: aluminum, for consistency with the engine case
material.grade: unidentified; the original is a casting whose grade is not published

titanium.galvanic_isolation: Not applicable: titanium is ruled out. That is precisely one of the reasons — a titanium case bolted to an aluminum engine case creates a galvanic couple that the TITANIUM.md grid rejects.

known_limits: No dimension, no material and no interface is established: the catalogue identifies, it does not dimension.
The grade of the original case is not published; "aluminum" is an inference from consistency with the engine case, not an identification.
The case carries the timing drive and pressurized oil: its failure can cost the engine, and the oil has hot neighbors on this plate, which includes a heat protection plate.
Titanium is ruled out by three independent contraindications from the grid: differential expansion against the aluminum case, threads reworked at every removal, galvanic couple with aluminum.
The real additive gain — consolidating the case, the bridges and the oil galleries — is not investigated and will not be without measuring a physical example.
